llm.summary: The skill is coherent with its description: it is an instruction + shell-script based slogan generator that runs locally, requests no credentials, and does not contact external endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (slogan generation, templates, translation, testing) match the provided scripts and SKILL.md. The scripts implement generation, testing, collections and a small data toolkit that is proportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and scripts only read their arguments and print canned templates/results. However the included scripts create and write to a data directory (history.log and data.log) under SLOGAN_MAKER_DIR/XDG_DATA_HOME/$HOME, so runtime behavior includes local logging of inputs/commands.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or remote downloads; this is an instruction-only skill with bundled shell scripts. No external packages or network-based installers are invoked.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No credentials or secret environment variables are required. The only env var referenced is SLOGAN_MAKER_DIR (optional) and the well-known XDG_DATA_HOME fallback; these are reasonable for controlling storage location.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated privileges, but it does persist data under a per-user data directory (~/.local/share/slogan-maker by default). That creates local artefacts (history.log, data.log) which may contain user-provided inputs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it says: a local slogan generator implemented in shell scripts. Before installing/running, note that it will create a directory under XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share/slogan-maker and append logs (history.log, data.log) containing command arguments and queries. It does not contact remote servers or require credentials. If you are concerned about leaving local traces, set SLOGAN_MAKER_DIR to a controlled/ephemeral path or inspect the scripts yourself; avoid passing highly sensitive secrets as slogan text since those values may be logged.
